name: Sonshine Acres
tagline: Sonshine Acres – A Homestead Style Ranch
description: A working pumpkin patch in Emmett, ID, Sonshine Acres grows Pumpkins, Corn, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Eggs. The patch is busiest in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
